about: Placement map for room-*.jpg (2560x1761 master). Objects: base-centre x/y and width, all in % of the image. Matches diorama-*.jpg exactly, so the HTML drag layer can sit on the plain room photo and look identical to the baked key art.

bulbPanel.about: The 5x4 bulb matrix on the stand is a real 20-pixel display. Centres in %; radius in % of image width. Light them in candy colours (status, scroll progress, a commit heatmap).

sunbeam.about: Brightest wall patch (good for a headline or a product in the light)

copySafeArea.about: Darkest calm wall area for overlay text
